findings.title: Exact source-derived mathematical statement
findings.resolution: Centered conditional residuals with E(U_i)=0 and zero conditional second moments imply x=y=0. Source gate1<=rhoLower<=rhoUpper is preserved; p is a point in(0,1/2]. The accepted same-law identity and all6 row signs/order match COUNT-RULES and the pinned source.
evidence: Bernoulli equality and rational-square equality controls

findings.resolution: Real SQLite/WAL transactions allow one active generation. Stale completion/checkpoint/renewal cannot replace the winner. Resume checks exact CAS bytes and diagnostic refs, and authorized_readback recomputes the small mathematical check even on a cache hit.

findings.title: Simple bounded exact algorithm and honest process profile
findings.resolution: Farkas checking uses O(m*d) exact rational operations for m6,d2. Producer tries only the two licensed strip directions; isqrt enclosures have exact square checks and perfect-rational-square handling. IO/digits/precision/wall limits are explicit. Windows does not claim POSIX CPU/address-space enforcement or full container isolation.

findings.title: Windows CAS hard-link publication and leaked SQLite connections
findings.resolution: The original os.link publication failed with WinError5 in the writable test workspace. Windows now uses create-only os.rename; POSIX retains hard-link installation. Read/constructor SQLite connections use contextlib.closing.
evidence: all5 durable-state tests now pass on this Windows host

findings.title: Atomic output temporary name exceeded Windows path limit
findings.resolution: The original outputbasename+UUID temporary path reached262 characters for an ordinary214-character work directory and failed before producing bytes. Short independent mkstemp names and explicit Windows path bounds replace it.
evidence: all actual CLI adversarial cases now pass using the same nested workspace paths

findings.title: Unsigned integer digit limit had a one-digit overrun
findings.resolution: The parser now counts digits after the optional minus; positive and negative2049-digit values are both rejected under the2048-digit limit.

findings.title: Reject oversized IO before hashing or unbounded allocation
findings.resolution: CAS checks byte length before SHA. The source profile allows exactly3 named public files and reads at most1MiB+1 per file before rejecting; it no longer reads arbitrary source bytes without a cap.
evidence: code review of fixed inventory and bounded read

findings.title: TOML location must not grant a new campaign or deadline
findings.origin: Root post-freeze review; auditor checked the fix and added legacy-head coverage.
findings.resolution: Runner uses one constant local-pilot head per state directory rather than hashing the absolute TOML path. Identical relocated inputs reuse the same campaign/cache. Frozen content/profile drift still fails closed. An existing different/legacy head is incompatible_state without explicit fresh; the database is not mistaken for empty.
evidence: new independent ledger regression: alternate locator without fresh rejected; explicit fresh allowed
real CLI relocation test: same campaign/frozen digest, both cache hits, attempts still2
source review: resume branch does not modify the original campaign deadline

limits: Only one point probability with exact zero centered conditional second moments is covered.
PILOT_PASS is a conditional infeasibility statement; it is not a full COUNT forest or Berry--Esseen proof.
Python/Fraction checker correctness and named analytic interpretation remain in the explicit trusted base.
Windows profile lacks a hard OS RAM/cgroup guarantee; subprocess separation is not a container security sandbox.
Cloud, whole-proof orchestration and all production family adapters remain unimplemented here.
Clean Git-copy/public installation check is coordinated separately by root, not claimed as part of these independent tests.
